title: Five live modules.
lead: Start with the module you need today and add the rest when you are ready. They all share the same assets, people and data.

items.name: HSEQ
items.outcome: Safer, compliant operations with records ready for any audit.
features: Incident reporting and root cause investigation
Planned and unplanned inspections with mobile checklists
Permits to work with approvals, isolations and gas tests
Corrective and preventive actions with owners and deadlines

image.alt: ALEF 360° HSEQ investigation board with incidents sorted by status and severity

items.name: CAFM | CMMS
items.outcome: Faster jobs and fewer breakdowns across every asset you look after.
features: Planned and reactive maintenance with work orders
Asset lifecycle, history and warranty in one record
Contracts, subcontractors and SLAs tracked automatically
Workforce scheduling and spare parts inventory

image.alt: ALEF 360° CAFM work orders list with statuses from pending to completed

items.name: iBMS
items.outcome: Live building monitoring that finds faults before people do.
features: Monitor HVAC, electrical and plumbing systems in real time
AI fault detection with smart prioritisation
Faults turn into work orders automatically
Energy and carbon tracking across many sites

image.alt: ALEF 360° iBMS map showing several residential facilities and their live system status

items.name: Connected Operations
items.outcome: Sensors and meters that show building health as it happens.
features: Indoor air quality, temperature and occupancy sensors
Smart metering for energy, water and gas
Leak and anomaly alarms sent to the right team
Works with the hardware and protocols you already use

image.alt: ALEF 360° IoT dashboard with air quality alarms and 2,500 connected devices

items.name: Mobility
items.outcome: Know where every vehicle and valuable asset is, right now.
features: Live fleet tracking and route monitoring
Driver assignment and route deviation alerts
Asset tracking for tools, equipment and containers
Movement alerts that prevent loss

image.alt: ALEF 360° Mobility route map tracking a freight truck with its assigned driver
